name: ridemate
description: RideMate monorepo – carpool matching for verified university students

scripts.dev:live: concurrently -n api,web,match -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:matcher"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,api,web,match -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green "npm run emulators" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:matcher"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && npm run test:matcher
